description: A helper class for parsing PROPFIND request bodies in a WebDAV server, handling XML parsing and property extraction.

classes.name: _parse_propfind
classes.description: A class for parsing PROPFIND request bodies, managing XML parsing state, and extracting properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser, opens input stream, sets up XML parser, and processes input to extract properties.

methods.name: _startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element, managing namespace and property collection based on depth.

methods.name: _endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, primarily decrementing the depth counter.
